items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: And our dear friend, Creed Taylor, who we’d recorded for many times

ctx.x: Trying to get the house together and whatever. It was hard though. We had to force ourselves. But we had to do it because we had the other girl.

And our dear friend, Creed Taylor, who we’d recorded for many times, said, “listen, it’s about time you guys start to do something.” I said, “gee I don’t know, Creed.” Well he says, “I’ve got an opening for you at the Half Note.”
